theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Technology (+0.97%) and Communication Svcs (+0.81%) led the market today, while Energy (-1.71%) and Consumer Staples (-1.07%) brought up the rear. Growth sectors outpaced the rest, averaging +0.37% versus -0.20% for defensives and -0.39% for value, consistent with risk appetite favoring higher-beta names. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 +0.32%, Dow +0.30%, Nasdaq +0.66% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps moved roughly in line with the broader market, with the Russell 2000 at +0.50%. The VIX fell 2.46% to 15.45, which reads as an orderly rotation rather than panic-driven selling. Gold added 0.59% to $4,715.90, crude oil was little changed at $81.09, and bitcoin slipped 0.91% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
